item.title: Voles
item.description: Red Voles Vole Nesting It is widely thought that voles primarily nest in old growth forest, but they have been sighted in nearby younger forest. The nests may be actively occupied, abandoned, etc. Nesting Research In order to quantify the voles occupancy in younger forests a multi-year survey has been conducted by researchers at OSU, NCASI? A large stretch of Western Oregon, from Coos Bay to ??? was split into four geographic study regions: North, North Central, South Central, South.
